thread:
Nora (CS): Quick heads-up: SailPointAI needs a short-term regional throughput bump for onboarding traffic spikes. They want APAC pinning (ap-southeast-2) and a peering allowlist for three CIDRs. Also asked for preserved headers for tracing. Need this active in ~6h.

Ben (Support): Please post org id + CIDRs. Also note if this is peering vs public. I'll prep the RLift ticket.

Nora (CS): Org: org_sail9. CIDRs: 150.101.200.0/24, 150.101.201.128/26, 198.18.0.0/29. They confirmed Azure ExpressRoute peering. Request: 2.5x throughput for 36h, autorevoke. Preserve headers: x-sail-trace, x-sail-user.

Ravi (NetEng): We can add peering ACLs and set region pinning. Would you like cache pre-warm? It helps p99 on initial ramp.

Nora (CS): Yes please, a small pre-warm (500 queries) if ops can authorize. Customer will allow test keys. Renewals note: campaign increases expected MRR; Maya to follow up.

Maya (AM): I'll loop in SalesOps and propose a short commitment if spend goes >2x baseline.

Ben (Support): Ticket #CS-4722 opened. Ops command for change: 

```
/rlift allowlist create --org org_sail9 --cidr 150.101.200.0/24 --cidr 150.101.201.128/26 --cidr 198.18.0.0/29 --regions ap-southeast-2 --throughput-multiplier 2.5 --duration 36h --autorevoke
```

Ben (Support): Added note to ticket: preserve headers x-sail-trace, x-sail-user; requested pre-warm 500 prompts (approved by AM). infra-bot: please queue change window.

infra-bot: Change queued: #CS-4722 -> window 04:30-05:00 UTC. Approve with :thumbsup:.

Maya (AM): Approved. :thumbsup:.

Ravi (NetEng): Applied peering ACLs and pinned route. Kicked warmup job (500 prompts) after customer provided test key. Verified connectivity from 150.101.200.12 and 150.101.201.140. Monitoring for 1h.

Ben (Support): Live confirmation sent to customer with ticket link. Monitoring shows expected throughput increase and no error spike. Will auto-revoke at 36h unless extended via ticket.

Nora (CS): Customer feedback: asked for a Console quick-action to request temporary bursts and to view active autorivokes. Filing as product suggestion in the ticket.

Maya (AM): Logged expected uplift for renewal discussion and noted potential ARR impact.

Ravi (NetEng): Leaving monitoring on for 24h. Will post revoke note when it runs.

Ben (Support): Closing thread: all actions complete.
